title: Composite of composition and restriction comparisons in a recovery equation
statement: Let C,E,D,K,V be categories [def-nagata-category]. Let T:C→D, A:C→E, B:E→D, S:E→K, P:K→V and R:D→V be functors (assignments on objects and morphisms preserving identities and composition). Supply natural isomorphisms e:T≅A⋙B and t:S⋙P≅B⋙R, meaning invertible component maps commuting with functor maps. Define moduleRecoveryComparisonIso(T,A,B,S,P,R,e,t):T⋙R≅(A⋙S)⋙P as e whiskered on the right by R, followed by the associator from (A⋙B)⋙R to A⋙(B⋙R), followed by t inverse whiskered on the left by A, followed by the inverse associator to (A⋙S)⋙P. Here ⋙ denotes successive application of functors; whiskering means applying a functor to components or precomposing component indices. This is an explicit composite, not a chosen witness of an existence theorem.
